name: ClickUp
one_liner: ClickUp offers a public REST API with OAuth2 authentication and an official MCP server for AI assistants.
auth_notes: Personal API tokens (pk_) can be used for personal or testing purposes; OAuth is required for multi‑user apps.
access_notes: Some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan, but the API is available on all ClickUp Plans.

extras.rate_limits: The ClickUp API enforces request rate limits per token. Rate limits vary depending on your Workspace Plan.

evidence.snippet: Build integrations and apps with our Public API.
For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Manage ClickUp tasks, lists, docs, and projects through ClickUp's official hosted remote MCP server.
Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps.
